# GoVanGoes Creative

> GoVanGoes Creative is a one-person creative business in Oviedo, Florida (Orlando area), run by GoVanGoes (Evan Figueroa), a rapper, producer, and audio engineer with about 18 years of performing experience. It offers live performance and hosting, remote mixing and mastering, and studio and acoustics guidance.

## Services

- Live performance, hosting/MC, appearances, brand events, and private-event performances. Quoted per request (date, length, location).
- Remote mixing and mastering for artists: Basic $79, Pro $129, Deluxe $199 per song. Add-ons: extra revision $15, stems export $25, same-day rush $50 (if available). Turnaround is typically 24 hours to 4 days depending on package and queue.
- Studio and acoustics guidance for home studios and project rooms. Quoted per project.
- Not offered yet: DJ and wedding packages.

## Key pages

- [Services and pricing](https://www.govangoes.com/services): what is offered, mix and master packages, FAQ.
- [Book a date](https://www.govangoes.com/bookings): request a live date. Requests are reviewed by hand and answered within 24 to 48 hours.
- [About](https://www.govangoes.com/about): background and highlights.
- [Press](https://www.govangoes.com/press): press features and press kit.
- [Contact](https://www.govangoes.com/contact)

## Facts

- Based in Oviedo, Florida. Serves the Orlando area in person and artists anywhere remotely for mixing and mastering.
- Top 3 at the Coast 2 Coast Showcase in Philadelphia. Featured in Rap Fiesta and Orlando Voyager.
- Contact: govangoes@gmail.com
